title: Measuring What Matters: A Framework for Evaluating Safety Risks in Real-World LLM Applications
findings: The paper's proposed framework for application-level safety testing includes religion as a protected characteristic within its 'Hateful' content risk category and as a topic in its 'Social Policies' risk category. The main finding is methodological, advocating for the inclusion of religion in customized, context-aware safety taxonomies to evaluate LLMs, rather than presenting empirical results about model performance on religious topics.
